cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says refugees or displaced people may hold SIM cards, mobile money or bank accounts as a rule; the one account held (SDN-004) is of a single displaced woman using a banking app in 2024, which does not carry the country. No count of displaced people with such services is held.
cells.note: The Commission for Refugees' UNHCR-approved registry exceeds 950,000 refugees under the Foreign Number system (SDN-002), so 3. A single displaced person paid through a banking app (SDN-004) does not show that displaced people may use such services, so not 4.
